name: Earn Your Freedom
source:
It's a game about a young guy who is captured by some bad guys and is forced to work in a brothel. Play the game to find out what will happen to him and if he'll become an obedient little slut.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/sissydreams]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
这是一款关于一个年轻人被坏人抓获并被迫在妓院工作的游戏。玩游戏看看他会发生什么，以及他是否会成为一个听话的小荡妇。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/sissydreams]Patreon[/url]]
